name: Chain Lightning
description: Fires a bolt chaining to 5 enemies within 200px. Each hit deals 28 damage and stuns for 1.5s. CD: 8s.

name: Flamethrower
description: Vents flame in a 90° cone (180px) for 3s: 12 dmg per 0.25s + fire DoT 6 dmg/s for 4s. CD: 12s.

name: Acid Gun
description: Fires a slow acid projectile. On impact: 60px splash, 35 damage, 50% slow for 3s. CD: 10s.

name: Backdoor Armor — Fire
description: When any hero is hit, the attacker takes 8 fire damage and is briefly ignited.

name: Backdoor Armor — Lightning
description: When any hero is hit, the attacker is stunned 0.6s and jolted for 10 damage.

name: Backdoor Armor — Spikes
description: When any hero is hit, the attacker takes 12 physical spike damage.

name: Dense Plating
description: All heroes always take 10% reduced damage (stacks with Backdoor Blockade).

name: Engineer's Efficiency
description: Habib's active ability cooldowns reduced by 25%.

name: Weighted Swing
description: Habib's melee damage increased by 20% and knockback increased by 30%.
